goal: Holistic upstreamable full-stack modernization across toolchain, HTTP security, SQLite FTS5, enrichment physics, PII isolation, and modern web frontend

steps.description: Fix .venv workspace isolation, migrate dev toolchain to PEP 735 dependency-groups (ruff, mypy, pytest), and build hermetic E2E SQLite test harness
Fix backend runtime NameErrors/AttributeErrors, add /api/trips/export.kml, and harden HTTP server security (path traversal, SSRF, ADB input, loopback/CORS/Sec-Fetch-Site, ETag/bfcache, CSP/CORP)
Unify tracked schema.sql + migrations, thread-local SQLite read/write pool, index pruning, external-content FTS5 search, N+1 elimination, and thread-safe NumPy CLIP vector search
Enforce enrichment pipeline physics, canonical GMS activity enums, Layer-2 user_decisions consistency, modular passes, and strict API/dominance verification gates
Sanitize all PII, personal addresses, Gaia IDs, and host filesystem paths across git-tracked code and documentation for clean upstreaming

Vendor frontend subresources locally, modularize static/app.js into native ES modules, fix 7 runtime bugs + 10 WCAG AA contrast violations + XSS/IME issues, and adopt native dialog/popover/tabs/@layer/content-visibility
Archive root binary/DB backups, purge live E2E test artifact row, document Baseline Browser Support Policy in AGENTS.md, and pass all 5 end-to-end verification gates
Archive pre-sanitization git history locally, configure privacy-safe GitHub noreply identity, replace main with a single zero-PII root commit, and upstream to origin/main
